About this item

  • 【90s Retro Cat-Eye Style】Embrace vintage charm with oval cat-eye frames inspired by 90s fashion. The narrow silhouette and upswept corners create a timeless look perfect for daily outfits.
  • 【UV400 Protection Lenses】The UV400 lenses block 100% of harmful UVA/UVB rays, reduce eye fatigue, and deliver clear, high-definition vision—ideal for driving, travel, and daily outdoor wear.
  • 【High-Quality & Lightweight】Crafted from ultra-light, eco-friendly polycarbonate for long-lasting comfort. The classic oval shape flatters a wide range of face shapes and is especially designed to suit heart-shaped, square, and small faces. One-piece nose pads reduce pressure for a comfy all-day fit.
  • 【Classic Style & Daily Protection】The dark lenses reduce glare for safe driving and sunny days out. Comes with a protective case and pouch to keep your shades scratch-free. The elegant, timeless frame makes them a must-have accessory for birthdays, parties, and festive fun.
  • 【Product Dimensions】Lens Width: 53mm (2.08 inches) | Lens Height: 31mm (1.22 inches) | Temple Length: 143mm (5.63 inches) | Nose Bridge: 18mm (0.71 inches). Perfectly sized for women looking for lightweight, retro-inspired oval sunglasses.

    I wanted to try these because I’ve been wanting some oval/cat eye Y2K sunglasses, but I wasn’t sure if they’d actually be cute in real life or look super small.

    They’re honestly even more flattering than expected and my favorite pair now. The shape gives a subtle lifted look without being too dramatic, and they feel lightweight and comfy on the face. Not too tight/loose and also don’t feel cheap or flimsy, which was a concern for me ordering sunglasses online.

    I also like that they come in multiple colors, so you can choose a shade depending on your outfits.

    Overall, they’re an easy everyday pair that instantly makes a basic outfit look more styled. Love them!

    These Phikttu Retro Oval Cat Eye sunglasses are a fantastic little find. They absolutely nail the Y2K vintage aesthetic with that perfectly petite, narrow frame – it’s a very specific, trendy look that avoids feeling costumey. The "retro oval" shape is key; it’s a softer, more modern take on a classic cat-eye, making them surprisingly versatile.

    The best part is how they wear. They are genuinely lightweight, which, combined with the narrow frame, makes them incredibly comfortable for all-day use. You barely feel them on your face, and there's no pinching on the temples or nose—a common issue with smaller vintage-style frames.

    Importantly, they don’t sacrifice function for form. The UV protection is essential, and the build quality feels well-built for the price point. The hinges are tight, and the materials feel sturdy without being heavy. They have a solid, confident click when you open or close them.

    In short: These are more than just a cute accessory. They’re a comfortable, well-made throwback that successfully bridges the gap between a trendy Y2K statement and a practical, everyday pair of sunnies. A total win if this is the silhouette you're after.

About this Item

  • 【90s Retro Cat-Eye Style】Embrace vintage charm with oval cat-eye frames inspired by 90s fashion. The narrow silhouette and upswept corners create a timeless look perfect for daily outfits.
  • 【UV400 Protection Lenses】The UV400 lenses block 100% of harmful UVA/UVB rays, reduce eye fatigue, and deliver clear, high-definition vision—ideal for driving, travel, and daily outdoor wear.
  • 【High-Quality & Lightweight】Crafted from ultra-light, eco-friendly polycarbonate for long-lasting comfort. The classic oval shape flatters a wide range of face shapes and is especially designed to suit heart-shaped, square, and small faces. One-piece nose pads reduce pressure for a comfy all-day fit.
  • 【Classic Style & Daily Protection】The dark lenses reduce glare for safe driving and sunny days out. Comes with a protective case and pouch to keep your shades scratch-free. The elegant, timeless frame makes them a must-have accessory for birthdays, parties, and festive fun.
  • 【Product Dimensions】Lens Width: 53mm (2.08 inches) | Lens Height: 31mm (1.22 inches) | Temple Length: 143mm (5.63 inches) | Nose Bridge: 18mm (0.71 inches). Perfectly sized for women looking for lightweight, retro-inspired oval sunglasses.

Product Description

Bring back the iconic 90s vibe with Phikttu Retro Oval Cat Eye Sunglasses. Designed with a slim, narrow oval frame and stylish upswept cat eye shape, these vintage-inspired sunglasses add a chic Y2K touch to any outfit. Whether you’re dressing up for a weekend trip, beach day, shopping, or everyday wear, they create an effortless fashion statement. Featuring UV400 protective lenses, these sunglasses help block harmful UVA and UVB rays while providing clear vision for outdoor activities. The lightweight polycarbonate frame offers comfortable wear without feeling heavy, making them ideal for all-day use. The compact oval silhouette is designed to complement a variety of face shapes, especially heart-shaped, square, and smaller faces. With a timeless retro design and versatile style, these sunglasses are the perfect accessory for casual outfits, vacations, parties, and seasonal fashion looks.
